title: Finally releasing my dice building autobattler I've been working on as a public playtest
author: luuk0987
selftext:
I’ve been working on Project Polyhedron for a while now. You buy faces in a shop, arrange them onto dice, and your dice fight builds other players saved earlier. .

The game is in Godot 4, and Claude Code wrote most of the code. What changed things for me was running several sessions at once, each on its own branch. One does the shop, one the fight screen, one balance, and so on. Then one session’s only job is merging everything into main, running the tests and pushing builds to itch. I mostly play the game, take screenshots, and tell whichever session owns that part what’s wrong.

There are about two dozen headless test scripts covering the rules, saves and online stuff. Without them the sessions would keep breaking each other’s work.

For balance I have bots that play the shop against each other, so I can find broken faces before players do. Though a couple of playtesting friends have already broken the game many times over. 

Every finished run gets uploaded to Supabase, and other players fight those snapshots later. Classic autobattler async pvp..

The art is all Stable Diffusion: Illustrious XL in ComfyUI for the hunters and every face icon. It's the weakes part of the game now, but I don't have the budget for a full on commission just yet.

Happy to answer questions about any of it.  
  
[https://wouwei.itch.io/project-polyhedron](https://wouwei.itch.io/project-polyhedron)
